turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided on Owen's zero, and did anyone speak to him first?
What would you want me to say to Owen tomorrow?
That's yours to work out, Hale. I asked who decided on the zero.
Like the actual words. Write it out for me and I'll read it to him.
I'm not writing your apology for you. Who decided?
